item.title: WATCH: Trump says 'I don't think about Americans' financial situation' in Iran negotiations
item.description: President Donald Trump said Americans' financial situation was "not even a little bit" of a motivating factor for him reaching a deal to end the war in Iran.

item.title: Russian ship that sank near Spain may have carried nuclear reactor parts
item.description: A Russian ship that sank after its engine room exploded in the Mediterranean could have been carrying parts for nuclear reactors used in submarines, according to Spanish government documents

item.title: Iran war looms over Trump’s visit to Beijing: ANALYSIS
item.description: Experts aren't expecting a "mega-deal" that would end the conflict.
